title: Protests and Unrest in the Streets of Paris

beats.text: Paris awoke to streets filled with shattered glass and burnt out cars.
People gathered to protest rising fuel prices and the high cost of living.
Demonstrations also targeted deteriorating public services and conditions in schools.
About 550,000 people took to the streets for these protests.
Police reported 1,800 arrests as some groups engaged in arson and looting.
Riot police turned tear gas and water cannons on the crowds.
The President of the National Assembly will propose a parliamentary inquiry.
Mayors of three cities asked for a meeting with the prime minister.
